steps.content: This battle is over. But it's merely the start of a bigger crisis.
In this interconnected Drifter Camp, the echoes travel in every direction, announcing the spread of the chaos.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Multiple locations in the Drifter Camp saw Corruptor derangement. The commercial district, water station, residential area, and clinic are all highly populated spots.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: There haven't been severe casualties so far, but many people have suffered mental shock. They may trip into Mania if their minds are not stabilized soon.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Lavina, get it together. We need you.
Ashen-faced, the red-haired woman trembles all over. Her body remains stiff for a while before she finally answers.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: ...Got it, I'll get to work right away.

steps.speaker: Options
options: Should we evacuate the Drifter Camp?

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: ...It'll be very difficult. I'll do what I can.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: And you? Are you going to continue your investigation?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'll find the Corpus and destroy it. Now that we're sure it's their scheme, I can't just let it be.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: ...I see.
He seems to have shifted to another communications device. The voice sounds distant.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Taran, you're nearby, aren't you? Do you have a map?

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Give it to him.
Lavina is shocked a bit by his words, and an even stronger protest comes from the other end of the device.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: This is an order. You want to let your temper get the best of you again?

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: Julien, I'll go.
She leaves. Soon, she comes back with a booklet and puts it in your hands carefully.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: This is an internal map of the Drifter Camp. It includes all the mechanisms, hidden passages, and passcodes. Elite squad clearance.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: Not many people in the camp have been to school, so Julien has made it as simple as possible. If you can't understand it, I can come with you.
You flip through it. Although the information is packed and diverse, it's organized and clear, each function and mechanism properly categorized.

steps.speaker: Options
options: Don't worry, I can read it. There are others who need you more.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: I'll try to keep in touch and give you the necessary instructions while commanding the others.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Now, go to elevator E7 and head to level 28 east. I've granted you access, and the key is written in the map. Just use it directly.

steps.speaker: Options
options: Should I search for the black raincoats from there?

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: No searching needed. In all the areas detected with abnormal M-values, only that place is desolate, but that's where several <color=#fb9259>men in black raincoats</color> appeared.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: If he decided to go all out, I figure this could be a chance to catch his weakness.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Level 28 east is highly contaminated to the point it's seriously interfering with the <color=#fb9259>anti-Mania monitoring system</color>. Once you're up there, I can't give you any more precise locations, and this communication device may not work either.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: If you need me, look for the communication terminals on the map. They have some anti-Mania effect and dial straight to my office. But there aren't that many of them, you'll have to rely on yourself most of the time.
You come to elevator E7 under Lavina's guidance. The upcoming battles must be even more dangerous. You won't let her come with you, so the map does offer great help. But you've still got a question.

steps.speaker: Options
options: Are you sure about giving me the map?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I suppose this is top secret to you. I recall that one of the objectives of the Executive Committee's infiltration into the camp is to scout the internal structure, so that they can breach this place.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: You won't cause us any issues.
He says firmly. A moment later, he adds.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: ...When it's all over, be sure to return it.
The smile has returned to Lavina's face. She shoves a few Hypercubes in your hands along with a fancy little box. You smell a weird fragrance.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: An outland essence oil to help you freshen up. Just now when I fetched the map, a friend wanted me to bring this to you. He wished to help, but was too shy to give it to you himself.
There's a hint of delight in her smile. You look back and find Greta peeking this way from the end of the alley. He hides back as soon as he sees you turn.
You wave in Greta's direction and bid farewell to the two from Rustfire. The elevator is here.

It's an open platform with an iron gate. When the gate opens, a handful of Rustfire members in protective cloaks carrying guns exit hurriedly to leave the elevator to the three of you. The gate shuts and the platform goes up.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ugh... This place looks huge, where do we even start...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, this is...
Something is stuck on the button of level 28. You peel it off and find that it's a memo. You open it and find only one word written on it.
Shackles

You freeze for a moment and begin sensing subconsciously... Indeed, somewhere above, someone connected to you through the shackles is there. It's K.K. What's happening to her there? Who's this person that left you this message...
You quickly peer down. The people who got out of the elevator haven't gone too far. As if sensing your gaze, one of them suddenly stops and looks back.
The cloak conceals his figure and you can't see his face clearly. He makes a gun with his hand and points it at you, shooting once silently.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Ah, it's that person. The undercover man from the 9th Agency.
"Rust" waves at you and turns to leave.
